observations: Natural Power-first states retain one common fresh golden-orange surface with cream point/toe caps, yellow hands/orb, pink chest/tail end and green torso back. Later targets develop orange/red bodies with gold, salmon, pink or magenta caps/orbs/toes. Gradual half-age states remain distinct from mature endpoints; actual idle leaning appears in some captured cases.

The original head cube and pixel eyes stay coherent. Power crown, rear point and side-horn caps are separate block ends. The exposed Power forehead, sides and original head top stay free of added stripes; the previously completed Run062 retains its separate top/central-crest lanes.

The front chest and cool inset torso-back regions appear correctly where exposed. Some back pixels are naturally occluded by small wings and the tail. Broad retained tail bases remain body-colored, authored roots stay connected and distal ends retain their separate pink/red or inherited accent pigment; the earlier broad pink base artifact is absent.

Red two-tone, red shiny, green mono, ruby and natural shiny retain their inherited body hues and semantic accent regions while the orb follows its separate species palette. Reflection highlights are visible on selected shiny/jewel body and foot surfaces in stills. Source-path/alpha checks establish eligibility of added opaque caps/wings for the same reflection field; this review does not certify a visibly moving glint on every added face.

All seven prior-family examples remain coherent across their six captured angles. The separate read-only preservation proof verifies eight old gameplay models, 22 prior material/region/appearance sources, 51 compiled prior class entries and twelve glasses/shine entries byte-exact to .62. All 172 original canonical coats retain transparent source pixels at the four new scoped swatches.

Pumpkin intentionally covers the head and added features. Rabbit replacements cover their corresponding parts while the exposed central crown, face and orb remain intact. The selected Phoenix wings and glasses remain fitted. Thin dotted/stippled round-glasses edges match the personally reopened .62 comparator and unchanged packaged accessories; this is inherited presentation, not a new cap/eye texture defect.
limits: This review covers 153 selected final stills through 24 sheets and 15 overlapping full-size reopens, not every pixel of all 796 saved PNGs. The older glasses comparator is context only. No earlier diagnostic image is promoted as final evidence.

RGB values, solid block caps and linear/bilinear interior development are authored approximations under different source-viewer and Minecraft lighting. Source zigzag rings and soft gradients are simplified, with the original cube proportions retained.

Shiny highlights were observed in stills. No continuous movie playback, listening, physical touch, independent remote multiplayer, complete world restart or every accessory/toy/coat combination was tested by this material reviewer.

The native client uses the development classpath. All 8,347 frozen/current production class and asset entries match the final JAR, with freeze before the first case and binding after completion; this does not claim that runClient loaded the archive.
